verdict.rationale: Snowflake publishes official OpenAPI-compliant REST API specifications plus importable Postman collections, which give users first-party, runnable API requests. However, running them requires importing into Postman. Nothing shows an interactive in-docs reference with a built-in 'try it' runner, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec served from the docs site. Missing for 10: interactive in-browser API explorer, embedded runnable examples in the docs, docs-hosted OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: These REST APIs are compliant with the OpenAPI specification.
In Postman client, click Import, then choose import folder
Snowflake REST APIs enable developers and partners to use the language of their choice to build integrations with Snowflake using the openAPI specifications.
